etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English strawbery, strauberi, from Old English strēawberġe, corresponding to straw +‎ berry.

definitions.definition: The sweet, usually red, edible fruit of certain plants of the genus Fragaria.
Any plant of the genus Fragaria (that bears such fruit).

quote.citation: 1886, Peter Christen Asbjørnsen, translated by H.L. Brækstad, Folk and Fairy Tales, page 170:
quote.text: He told his father, and said it would be just suitable work for him to run about fields and woods amongst the strawberry hills after a flock of hares, and now and then lie down and take a nap on some sunny hill.

definitions.definition: A dark pinkish red color, like that of the fruit; strawberry red.
(rare) Something resembling a strawberry, especially a reddish bruise, birthmark, or infantile hemangioma (naevus).
